# kala_tasks (Data Source)

Lists the tasks (checklist items) of one case.

`case_id` is **required**: Kala addresses checklist items by case, and there is no account-wide task endpoint. Reading every task would mean one request per case.

To read tasks across several cases, combine with `kala_cases` and `for_each` rather than expecting this data source to fan out.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A Kala "task" is a checklist item on a case.
#
# `case_id` is REQUIRED: Kala addresses checklist items by case and has no
# account-wide task endpoint.

data "kala_tasks" "for_case" {
  case_id = 1

  # Applied upstream:
  # search          = "roof"
  # name_contains   = "gutter"
  # only_unfinished = true

  # Applied client-side — Kala has no assignee parameter. This narrows the
  # RESULT without reducing what was read, so `complete` still describes the
  # underlying read rather than the filtered list.
  # assignee_worker_nr = 1
}

# Tasks across several cases are a for_each composition, not a provider fan-out.
data "kala_cases" "active" {}

data "kala_tasks" "per_case" {
  for_each = { for c in data.kala_cases.active.cases : tostring(c.id) => c }

  case_id         = each.value.id
  only_unfinished = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `case_id` (Number) The case whose tasks to read. This is the integer `id` from `kala_cases`, **not** the string case number.

### Optional

- `assignee_worker_nr` (Number) Return only tasks whose responsible worker matches. **Applied client-side** -- Kala has no assignee parameter -- so it narrows the result without reducing what was read. `complete` still reflects the underlying read.
- `include_contact_details` (Boolean) Expose assignee and authorship fields. Off by default.
- `include_financials` (Boolean) Expose hours and price fields. Off by default.
- `name_contains` (String) Name substring filter applied upstream.
- `only_unfinished` (Boolean) Return only unfinished tasks. Applied upstream. Defaults to `false`, which returns all.
- `search` (String) Free-text filter applied upstream.

### Read-Only

- `case_finished` (Number) Case-level finished-task count, unaffected by filters.
- `case_total` (Number) Case-level task count, unaffected by filters.
- `complete` (Boolean) Whether the read covered every task on the case. Reflects records **received**, so a client-side `assignee_worker_nr` filter does not make it false.
- `tasks` (Attributes List) The tasks returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tasks))
- `total` (Number) How many tasks the case holds, as reported upstream.

<a id="nestedatt--tasks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tasks`

Read-Only:

- `assigned_to_me` (Boolean) Whether the task is assigned to the authenticating user. **Null unless `include_contact_details` is set** -- this identifies a person.
- `assignee_worker_nr` (Number) Employee number of the responsible worker. **Null unless `include_contact_details` is set** -- this identifies a person. Null also when unassigned.
- `billed_hours` (Number) Hours billed. **Null unless `include_financials` is set.**
- `case_id` (Number) The case this task belongs to.
- `case_number` (String) The case number, e.g. `KA-1`.
- `checklist_id` (Number) The checklist this item belongs to.
- `created_by` (String) Who created the task. **Null unless `include_contact_details` is set** -- this identifies a person.
- `deadline` (String) Deadline as RFC 3339. Null when unset.
- `description` (String) Task description.
- `finished_by` (String) Who completed the task. **Null unless `include_contact_details` is set** -- this identifies a person.
- `has_image` (Boolean) Whether a photo has been attached.
- `id` (Number) Checklist item id.
- `image_required` (Boolean) Whether completing the task requires a photo.
- `invoice_mode` (String) How the task is invoiced, e.g. `REG_HOURS&SPECIAL`.
- `is_finished` (Boolean) Whether the task is complete.
- `name` (String) Task name.
- `note_required` (Boolean) Whether completing the task requires a note.
- `price_fixed` (Number) Fixed price, when one is set. **Null unless `include_financials` is set.**
- `registered_hours_total` (Number) Hours registered against the task. **Null unless `include_financials` is set.**
- `status_name` (String) Status label. **Not translated** -- these are the tenant's own values from the company-wide `kanban_options` setting, so they appear in whatever language that setting uses.
- `time_added` (String) When the task was created, as RFC 3339.
- `time_finished` (String) When it was completed, as RFC 3339. Null when unfinished.
